content: Kriti Mahajan followed up with insurance agent Vikram Patel regarding the processing time for a policy reinstatement form, which is 3-5 business days. She also inquired about the reinstatement fee amount, which Vikram confirmed is a one-time charge of $25. Kriti stated she would submit the form today and requested a confirmation upon receipt.

action_items: Kriti to send the completed reinstatement form today
Vikram to confirm receipt of the form once received
